title: 機械工学専門実験・演習Ｂ
subtitle: Mechanical Engineering Major Lab/ Exercises B
teachers:
KISHI Yoichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Acquire sufficient understanding and application of the following specialized subjects: mechanical processing, materials science, and internal combustion engine.
(2) Acquire technical writing skills.
(3) Learn how to create presentation materials and presentation scripts.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:
 Mechanical processing: cutting conditions, tool geometry, cutting force, and surface finish
 Manufacturing systems: numerical control (NC), NC lathe, and NC simulator
 Materials Science: Observation of microstructures and hardness testing
 Energy and Power: Fuel economy, thermal efficiency and energy conversion system

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class.
Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
requiredKnowledge:
Preview and review related specialized subjects.
Create and submit technical preparatory reports before each experimental class.
Have basic knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Know how to use a calculator and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize the experimental results.
Be able to actively participate in experiments based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to consider the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to evaluate the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to use the kinematics model to determine the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
Be able to submit and explain your experimental results as a technical report.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Create thorough technical reports on experimental results using a computer.
(2) Proactively participate systematically in class experiments based on the related specialized subjects.
(3) Consider and evaluate your experimental results according to the related specialized subjects.
(4) Use the kinematics model to compare experimental and theoretical results.
(5) Explain experimental results in a thorough technical report and submit it for evaluation.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Create technical reports on experimental results using a computer.
(2) Participate in class experiments based on related specialized subjects.
(3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects.
(4) Compare the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
(5) Explain experimental results in a technical report and submit it for evaluation.

lessons.content:
Experiments in Mechanical Processing (1)
Effect of tool geometry on cutting force and
machined surface
Evaluate cutting characteristics in four
groups. Select the optimum conditions from the
experimental results using the cutting edge
angle and nose radius as parameters.

preparatory reports

lessons.content:
Experiments in Mechanical Processing (2)
Effect of cutting conditions on cutting force
and machined surface
Evaluate cutting characteristics in four groups.
Select the optimum conditions from the results
using the cutting speed and feed rate as
parameters.

Experiments in Mechanical Processing (3)
Review reports summarizing experimental results
and considerations conducted in classes 4 and 5.
